passages.text: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying, “Son of man, how does the wood of the vine surpass any other branch among the trees in the forest?
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to me.
He said these words to me.
He called me "son of man."
He asked me a question.
He asked about the wood of the vine.
He asked if the wood of the vine is better than any other wood.
He asked if the vine branch is better than the branches of the trees in the forest.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃ בֶּן־ אָדָ֕ם מַה־ יִּֽהְיֶ֥ה עֵץ־ הַגֶּ֖פֶן מִכָּל־ עֵ֑ץ הַזְּמוֹרָ֕ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיָ֖ה בַּעֲצֵ֥י הַיָּֽעַר׃

passages.text: Can wood be taken from it to make something useful? Or can one make from it a peg on which to hang utensils?
passages.sermon:
The Lord spoke to Ezekiel.
He asked about the wood of the vine.
The Lord compared the vine to other trees in the forest.
He asked if people can take wood from the vine to make something useful.
He asked if people can make a peg from the vine’s wood.
He asked if anyone can hang utensils on such a peg.
passages.original: הֲיֻקַּ֤ח מִמֶּ֙נּוּ֙ עֵ֔ץ לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת לִמְלָאכָ֑ה אִם־ יִקְח֤וּ מִמֶּ֙נּוּ֙ יָתֵ֔ד לִתְל֥וֹת עָלָ֖יו כָּל־ כֶּֽלִי׃

passages.text: No, it is cast into the fire for fuel. The fire devours both ends, and the middle is charred. Can it be useful for anything?
passages.sermon:
The wood of the vine is not useful for making things.
People throw it into the fire to be burned.
The fire burns both ends of the wood.
The fire also chars the middle of the wood.
This wood cannot be used for any purpose.
passages.original: הִנֵּ֥ה לָאֵ֖שׁ נִתַּ֣ן לְאָכְלָ֑ה אֵת֩ שְׁנֵ֨י קְצוֹתָ֜יו אָכְלָ֤ה הָאֵשׁ֙ וְתוֹכ֣וֹ נָחָ֔ר הֲיִצְלַ֖ח לִמְלָאכָֽה׃

passages.text: Even when it was whole, it could not be made useful. How much less can it ever be useful when the fire has consumed it and charred it!
passages.sermon:
The wood is a vine branch.
The vine branch is not useful for making things.
Even when the vine branch is whole, people cannot use it for work.
Fire burns the vine branch.
The fire eats the vine branch and chars it.
After the fire, the vine branch is even less useful.
People cannot use the burned vine branch for any work.
passages.original: הִנֵּה֙ בִּֽהְיוֹת֣וֹ תָמִ֔ים לֹ֥א יֵֽעָשֶׂ֖ה לִמְלָאכָ֑ה אַ֣ף כִּי־ אֵ֤שׁ אֲכָלַ֙תְהוּ֙ וַיֵּחָ֔ר וְנַעֲשָׂ֥ה ע֖וֹד לִמְלָאכָֽה׃ס

passages.text: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Like the wood of the vine among the trees of the forest, which I have given to the fire for fuel, so I will give up the people of Jerusalem.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks with authority.
He compares the people of Jerusalem to the wood of a vine.
The wood of a vine grows among the trees of the forest.
This vine wood is not strong or useful like other trees.
God gives this vine wood to the fire as fuel.
In the same way, God will give up the people of Jerusalem.
God will hand them over, just as He gives the vine wood to be burned.
passages.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר עֵץ־ הַגֶּ֙פֶן֙ בְּעֵ֣ץ הַיַּ֔עַר אֲשֶׁר־ נְתַתִּ֥יו לָאֵ֖שׁ לְאָכְלָ֑ה כֵּ֣ן נָתַ֔תִּי אֶת־ יֹשְׁבֵ֖י יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

passages.text: And I will set My face against them. Though they may have escaped the fire, yet another fire will consume them. And when I set My face against them, you will know that I am the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The Lord is speaking about the people of Jerusalem.
The Lord says, "I will turn My face against them."
Some people may escape one fire.
But another fire will destroy them.
I will set My face against them.
Then you will know that I am the Lord.
passages.original: וְנָתַתִּ֤י אֶת־ פָּנַי֙ בָּהֶ֔ם מֵהָאֵ֣שׁ יָצָ֔אוּ וְהָאֵ֖שׁ תֹּֽאכְלֵ֑ם וִֽידַעְתֶּם֙ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה בְּשׂוּמִ֥י אֶת־ פָּנַ֖י בָּהֶֽם׃

passages.text: Thus I will make the land desolate, because they have acted unfaithfully,’ declares the Lord GOD.”
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
He will make the land empty and ruined.
The people have acted unfaithfully.
This is the reason for the desolation.
The Lord GOD has declared this.
passages.original: וְנָתַתִּ֥י אֶת־ הָאָ֖רֶץ שְׁמָמָ֑ה יַ֚עַן מָ֣עֲלוּ מַ֔עַל נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃פ
